title: Hawara labyrinth and the 2008 Mataha expedition GPR scan

tellings.quote: There was an expedition, I think it was 2008 called the Mataha expedition. They GPR scanned it. They found that there's a huge slab, limestone slab, that's actually not the floor, but actually the roof of this underground chamber system.

plain: Under the Hawara labyrinth in Egypt lies a system of underground chambers: a 2008 expedition called Mataha scanned the site with ground-penetrating radar and found that a huge limestone slab there is not a floor but the roof of those chambers. Geoffrey Drumm, a researcher of the pyramids, tells Michels this, saying he thinks the year was 2008, and draws on the work of Ben van Kerkwijk. If true, a large hidden complex would still be waiting to be opened.
